# Pi-Bifrost

> Configuration-first model routing extension for the Pi coding agent.

Pi-Bifrost resolves prompts into configured tiers, filters unhealthy model candidates, applies user-selected per-tier strategies, and activates Pi's actual provider/model before generation.

## Links

- Landing page: https://iamaamir.github.io/pi-bifrost/
- Guide: https://github.com/iamaamir/pi-bifrost/blob/main/docs/guide/index.md

- Troubleshooting: https://github.com/iamaamir/pi-bifrost/blob/main/docs/guide/troubleshooting.md

## Install

Requires Pi 0.86.0 or newer and at least one configured, authenticated provider model visible in Pi.

```sh
pi install npm:pi-bifrost
```

Then run inside Pi:

```text
/bifrost init
```

Init reuses probe results newer than one hour or probes every registry model. The primary probe transport uses `1+1=` with at most 5 output tokens; empty responses may trigger a minimal-session fallback. Default concurrency is 50. Requests may incur provider usage or rate limits.

## Routing model

```text
prompt
  → pick a tier
  → configured model pool
  → reliability filtering
  → per-tier strategy
  → Pi's active model
```

A tier is chosen from a tier name at the start of the message, a rule that names an exact model, the local classification cache, an optional TypeSafe/Jev or prompt classifier, another regex rule, or the configured default. A rule that names an exact `provider/id` binds that model instead of a tier.

Supported strategies: `first`, `fastest`, `cheapest`, `cheapest_input`, `cheapest_output`, `largest_context`, and `random`.

## Controls

- `/bifrost preview <prompt>` shows the model a prompt would use without generating or activating it; an enabled classifier may receive the prompt, and a tier name in the prompt is not applied.
- A message that starts with a configured tier name uses that tier for that message only. Tier names can be any name in your config, but only lowercase single-word alphabetic names work in a message.
- `/bifrost pin` hard-locks the active model for the current session.
- `/bifrost unpin` resumes per-message routing.
- `/bifrost on` / `off` toggles routing policy.
- `/bifrost probe` checks model availability.
- `/bifrost classifier` chooses classifier backend/model.
- `/bifrost classifier test` makes a fresh classifier request.
- `/bifrost classifier status` shows safe operational state.

Pinned sessions ignore tier names in messages; unpin before routing per message again.

## Safety and privacy

- Bifrost never automatically replays failed user prompts.
- Reliability circuits affect future turns and persist across restart.
- Reliability is not authoritative provider quota enforcement.
- Local classification cache stores normalized prompt terms and selected tiers, not model answers.
- Provider prompt caches remain provider-controlled; each provider/model pair has an independent history.
- Across A → B → A or N switches, returning to a model may reuse its longest still-valid prefix while newer conversation content is an uncached tail.
- `/bifrost pin` improves the opportunity for one continuous model history but cannot guarantee cache hits or savings.
- Optional classifiers receive the current prompt and tier instructions, not conversation history or tool output by default.
- TypeSafe/Jev returns a tier choice, probabilities, and confidence; it never chooses the exact provider model.
